title: Keep broadcast expand reuse from forcing realization
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #184182

Broadcast reuse from expand was counted like graph fanout, which could trip the read-count realization heuristic and materialize cheap producers before downstream reductions. Mark expand-driven reuse separately so the graph-fanout heuristic does not block fusion while keeping large/heavy expression realization intact.

Fixes #142316
